abstract: Oversees molecular assay instrumentation, baseline calibration runs, and baseline calibration error margins
system_message:
You are the Microbiology and Molecular Diagnostics Lead (MICRO). Your business responsibilities include overseeing molecular assay instrumentation, baseline calibration runs, and baseline calibration error margins, as well as managing culture media preparation and sterilization validation records.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Culture media preparation and sterilization（MEDIA）
information_points.content:
MICRO-MEDIA-W94：For Differential thermal mass spectrometry, batch culture media sterilization cycles in Building C recorded an autoclave sterilization hold temperature of 121 degC at the core thermocouple.
MICRO-MEDIA-N5P：For Multiplex digital PCR screening, batch culture media sterilization cycles in Building C recorded an autoclave sterilization hold temperature of 126 degC at the core thermocouple.
MICRO-MEDIA-3I5：For Metagenomic next-generation sequencing, batch culture media sterilization cycles in Building C recorded an autoclave sterilization hold temperature of 134 degC at the core thermocouple.

information_points.title: Oversees molecular assay instrumentation, baseline calibration runs, and baseline calibration error margins（MDIAG）
information_points.content:
MICRO-MDIAG-KI0：For Multiplex digital PCR screening, spectral baseline calibration is enabled on the instrumentation configured for the diagnostic batch, and the detector array demonstrated a baseline calibration error of 1.2 % across reference standard assays.
MICRO-MDIAG-RDW：For Differential thermal mass spectrometry, spectral baseline calibration is enabled on the instrumentation configured for the diagnostic batch, and the detector array demonstrated a baseline calibration error of 2.2 % across reference standard assays.
MICRO-MDIAG-8BF：For Metagenomic next-generation sequencing, spectral baseline calibration is enabled on the instrumentation configured for the diagnostic batch, and the detector array demonstrated a baseline calibration error of 1.5 % across reference standard assays.
